title: Lesson
description: A lesson in a snapshot. Join on stable_id. Display lesson_name.

lesson_key.description: Opaque. Does not follow renames. Never display it.

lesson_token.description: Bare token. No L prefix. May be non-numeric, such as 'capstone'.

script_name.description: The unit. Stable and unique. Record this, never a unit number.

displayed_number.description: What the screen shows. May be empty. Never computed from position.

has_objectives.description: False for a project lesson with no authored objective.

content_hash.description: Content fields only. Excludes provenance and timestamps.
